mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 41 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall and we are currently in a new moon phase.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive Reconstruction Project. Phase two is currently underway, with contractors focusing on concrete curbs, sidewalks, and preparing the roadway for asphalt.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, take a yoga class at Insight Wellness, or grab pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, join the fun with trivia at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, or the ART House 360 events.

In a recent report, on October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they found a man passed out behind the wheel. The individual was taken into custody for an O W I offence.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the decadent Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit accordingly.
